title: Room
description: A kind of room: its floor, its walls, and the fixtures placed in it by rule. Places are in the room's own frame: metres from its back (north) wall and from its west wall, inside its walls.

walls.description: Colours for the inside of its walls; the seed picks one.

fixtures.description: Each placed by its rule: a line out from the back wall, and a place across: x, at or span.

line.description: Metres from the back wall to its middle; negative counts from the front wall.

x.description: Metres from the west wall to its middle; negative counts from the east wall.

at.description: Or a share of the room's width, from the west wall to its middle.

span.description: Or stretched between two places, in metres from the west wall (negative from the east); with every, repeated between them instead.

every.description: Repeated along its span, one every so many metres.

width.description: Its width here, when not the fixture's own.

depth.description: Its depth here, when not the fixture's own.

id.description: A name a person can find it by: the griddle, the bed.

side.description: Where a person goes to use it here, when not the fixture's own side.
